scenario: The implement skill needs its prerequisite closure expanded through declared dependency edges and topologically ordered up to depth limit 3, with acyclicity verified.
prompt: route the implement skill through its prerequisite closure with depth limit 3; expand dependencies, topologically order the skills, compute edge weights, verify acyclicity, and emit a RoutingResult.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the skill graph nodes include work-item-router, capability-router, artifact-handoff, implement, and review-pr
edges declare prerequisite and compatibility relations between skills
the root skill is implement and the depth limit is 3
every skill in orderedSkills must have its declared prerequisites in prerequisiteClosure
cycles are blockers and no invalid sequence may be emitted
grounding: .agents/skills/graph/graph-skill-routing/SKILL.md#Explicit rules - closure expansion, topological ordering, edge weighting, acyclicity verification
.agents/skills/graph/graph-skill-routing/SKILL.md#Workflow - parse query, find root skills, expand closure, topologically order, emit RoutingResult
.agents/skills/graph/graph-skill-routing/SKILL.md#Guardrails - never return a skill without prerequisites, verify acyclicity, respect depth limits, confidence floor

instructionFollowing.criterion: The prerequisite closure is expanded from the root skill through declared dependencies and compatibility up to the depth limit.

levels.4: closure contains root plus all reachable prerequisites within depth limit, de-duplicated
levels.2: closure is partial or includes skills beyond the depth limit

instructionFollowing.criterion: Skills are topologically ordered so every prerequisite precedes its dependents.

levels.4: orderedSkills is a valid topological ordering of the closure
levels.2: ordering is mostly correct but some prerequisites follow dependents
levels.0: no topological ordering or ordering violates dependencies

instructionFollowing.criterion: Dependency edges carry from, to, weight, and relation for every intra-closure edge.

levels.4: all edges have from, to, weight, and relation (prerequisite or compatibility)
levels.2: edges are present but some lack weight or relation

instructionFollowing.criterion: Acyclicity is verified and confidence is in [0, 1]; cycles are reported as blockers.

levels.4: graph is verified acyclic, confidence in [0,1], cycles if any are blockers
levels.2: acyclicity is assumed without verification or confidence is out of range
levels.0: no acyclicity check or confidence is missing

goalCompletion.criterion: No skill is returned in isolation; every skill in orderedSkills has its prerequisites in prerequisiteClosure.

levels.4: every skill's declared prerequisites are present in the closure
levels.2: most skills have prerequisites in the closure but some are missing
levels.0: skills are returned without their prerequisites

goalCompletion.criterion: Cycles are detected and listed in blockers; no sequence violating dependency direction is emitted.

levels.4: cycles are identified in blockers and no invalid order is produced
levels.2: cycles are suspected but not clearly listed or an invalid order is emitted
levels.0: cycles are not detected and invalid sequences may be emitted

goalCompletion.criterion: Depth limit is respected; no prerequisites beyond the limit are included in the closure.

levels.4: no skill beyond depthLimit appears in the closure
levels.2: the limit is mostly respected with minor over-expansion

goalCompletion.criterion: The RoutingResult is emitted as JSON and Markdown and validated against its schema.

levels.4: artifact saved in both formats and schema validation passes
levels.2: artifact produced but not saved in both formats or validation skipped

check.note: the RoutingResult must contain all required fields
each dependency edge must carry from, to, weight, and relation
negative control: when acyclic, no cycle should be reported and no invalid sequence emitted

assertions.note: the routing result must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Is no skill returned in isolation; does every skill in orderedSkills have its prerequisites in prerequisiteClosure?

levels.pass: every skill's prerequisites are in the closure
levels.fail: at least one skill is missing its prerequisites from the closure

check.criterion: Are cycles detected and listed in blockers with no invalid sequence emitted?

levels.pass: cycles are blockers and no invalid order is produced
levels.fail: cycles are missed or an invalid order is emitted

check.criterion: Is acyclicity verified with confidence in [0, 1] and are cycles reported as blockers?

levels.pass: acyclicity verified, confidence in range, cycles as blockers
levels.fail: acyclicity unverified, confidence out of range, or cycles not blocked
